info.title: SIDE ROOM API
info.description: Discord-shaped REST API. `/api/v10` is an alias of `/api/v1`.

get.summary: Page through the staff access log, newest first (`VIEW_ACCESS_LOG`).
Verify the whole hash chain (`VIEW_ACCESS_LOG`). A break raises a staff alert.
Search accounts (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`), paginated by id.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Username, display name, email fragment or exact id

get.summary: Account drawer (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`). The read is logged.

post.summary: Platform-ban the Person behind an account (`PLATFORM_BAN`).

get.summary: Credit balance and ledger (newest first).

post.summary: Grant or revoke invite credits with a reason.
Record an account deletion request (stub: nothing is deleted) (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`).
Revoke every session of an account (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`).

get.summary: Accounts invited, directly or not, up to `depth` hops (at most 500 nodes).
Inviter chain (root first) and stats of an account. The read is logged.

post.summary: Remove TOTP, recovery codes and passkeys and end all sessions (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`).
Suspend (deactivate) an account; its sessions end (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`).
Reactivate a suspended account if the account cap allows (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`).

get.summary: List platform bans, newest first (`PLATFORM_BAN`).
Uploaded videos, newest first (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

parameters.name: title_id
parameters.description: Only assets uploaded for this title.

post.summary:
Reserve an upload slot for an original and get the presigned multipart `PUT` URLs
(`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).
post.description:
Send each part of the file (`part_size` bytes, the last one shorter) to its URL with `PUT`
and keep the `ETag` response header of every part, then call the `complete` endpoint with the
parts. A slot that is never completed expires after a day. Files over the configured size
limit (`cinema.upload.max_gb`) and unknown containers are refused with 400.

503.description: Object storage did not start the upload.

get.summary:
An asset with its jobs and a summary of its probe: poll this after completing the upload
(`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

post.summary:
The file is uploaded: finish the multipart upload, check the object and queue the probe
(`PUBLISH_MEDIA`). Repeating the call for an asset past the upload returns it unchanged.

400.description: The storage did not accept the parts, or the file is empty, over the limit or not the announced size.

put.summary:
Record which title or episode an asset is for and, once it is playable, link it in the
catalog as the video of that title or episode (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

409.description: The asset has no playable renditions yet.

put.summary:
Allow (or stop allowing) members with the download perk to fetch the original file
(`PUBLISH_MEDIA`). An asset with this on keeps its original on the hot tier.

post.summary:
Probe the original again, for example after FFmpeg was installed on the server
(`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).
Queue the ladder transcode of an asset that waited for approval (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

get.summary: Every collection, drafts included (`MANAGE_COLLECTIONS`).

post.summary: Create a collection (`MANAGE_COLLECTIONS`).

get.summary: A collection with its titles in order, drafts included (`MANAGE_COLLECTIONS`).

put.summary: Replace the settings of a collection (`MANAGE_COLLECTIONS`).

delete.summary: Delete a collection (`MANAGE_COLLECTIONS`).

put.summary: Replace the titles of a collection, in display order (`MANAGE_COLLECTIONS`).
Hide a comment from every listing, or restore it. Hiding closes its open reports as `actioned`.
Replace the editable fields of an episode (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`). The asset link is untouched.

delete.summary: Delete an episode (`DELETE_CONTENT`). Deleting the last playable thing of a published title unpublishes it.

put.summary: Link or unlink the playable asset of an episode (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`). Unlinking unpublishes the episode.

get.summary: Skip windows of an episode, published or not (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

put.summary: Replace the skip windows of an episode (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

post.summary: Publish an episode (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`). An episode without an asset stays a draft (409).
Unpublish an episode (`PUBLISH_MEDIA` or `DELETE_CONTENT`).

get.summary: The report queue for reviews and comments, newest first, with an excerpt of the reported text.

post.summary: Close a report as `actioned` or `dismissed` (or reopen it with `open`).

put.summary: Hide a review from every listing, or restore it. Hiding closes its open reports as `actioned`.
Replace the editable fields of a season (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

delete.summary: Delete a season with its episodes (`DELETE_CONTENT`).

post.summary: Add an episode (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

get.summary: All titles, drafts included (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

parameters.name: published
parameters.description: `true` for published, `false` for drafts and unpublished titles.

post.summary: Create a draft title (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

get.summary: A title with everything under it, published or not (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

put.summary: Replace the editable fields of a title (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`). The asset link is untouched.

delete.summary: Delete a title with everything under it (`DELETE_CONTENT`).

post.summary:
Reserve an artwork object for a title and get a presigned `PUT` URL (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).
Upload the image with the same `Content-Type`, then save the returned `key` as the
title's `poster_key` / `backdrop_key` / `logo_key`, an episode's `still_key` or a
season's `poster_key`.

put.summary: Link or unlink the playable asset of a film (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).
Replace the skip windows of a title (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`): at most one of each kind, inside 24 hours.

post.summary:
Merge this title into another (`PUBLISH_MEDIA` and `DELETE_CONTENT`): seasons, episodes,
variants, trailers, markers and collection places move (the target wins a clash and fills
its gaps from this title); this title stays as a redirect.
Publish a title (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`). A title without a playable asset or a published episode stays a draft (409).
Add a season (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).
Add a trailer to a title (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).
Unpublish a title (`PUBLISH_MEDIA` or `DELETE_CONTENT`).
Add a variant (another cut) to a title (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

put.summary: Replace a trailer (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

delete.summary: Delete a trailer (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

put.summary: Replace a variant (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

delete.summary: Delete a variant (`PUBLISH_MEDIA`).

get.summary:
List the registered feature modules with their platform state (`MANAGE_FEATURES`).
The registry may be sparse: only registered features appear.

patch.summary: Enable, disable or configure a feature at the platform scope (`MANAGE_FEATURES`).

get.summary: List platform invites, newest first.

delete.summary: Revoke an open invite.

get.summary: List jobs, newest first (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`).

delete.summary: Delete a dead job (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`).

post.summary: Re-queue a dead job (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`).

put.summary: Change a chapter's number, title, volume or release group (`PUBLISH_READING`).

delete.summary: Delete a chapter and its pages (`DELETE_CONTENT`).

get.summary: Preview a chapter's page manifest, published or not (`PUBLISH_READING`).

put.summary:
Replace the whole page list of an image chapter: this is how pages are reordered,
replaced and removed (`PUBLISH_READING`). Object keys must live under
`library/{series_id}/{chapter_id}/`.

post.summary: Publish a chapter; it needs pages (`PUBLISH_READING`).
Unpublish a chapter (`PUBLISH_READING` or `DELETE_CONTENT`).

get.summary: The latest uploads of a chapter, newest first (`PUBLISH_READING`).

post.summary: Reserve an upload slot for a chapter's file and get the presigned `PUT` URL (`PUBLISH_READING`).
post.description:
The file's extension must fit the chapter's format (`.cbz .zip .cb7 .7z .cbr .rar` for
images, `.epub`, `.pdf`). Send the bytes to `upload_url` with `PUT`, then call the
`complete` endpoint. A slot that is never completed expires after a day.

409.description: The chapter already has an upload being converted, or uploads are not available.

put.summary: Change an edition (`PUBLISH_READING`).

delete.summary: Delete an edition and its chapters (`DELETE_CONTENT`).

post.summary: Add a draft chapter to an edition (`PUBLISH_READING`).
Add a volume to an edition (`PUBLISH_READING`).

get.summary: All series, drafts included (`PUBLISH_READING`).

parameters.name: genres
parameters.description: Comma-separated genres the series must have.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated tags the series must have.

parameters.name: published
parameters.description: `true` for published, `false` for drafts and unpublished series.

post.summary: Create a draft series (`PUBLISH_READING`).

get.summary: A series with its editions, published or not (`PUBLISH_READING`).

put.summary: Replace the editable fields of a series (`PUBLISH_READING`).

delete.summary: Delete a series with everything under it (`DELETE_CONTENT`).

get.summary: Editions, volumes and every chapter of a series, published or not (`PUBLISH_READING`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 500. Without it every chapter is returned.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: `asc` (default) or `desc`: edition, then chapter number, then id.

post.summary: Add an edition (`PUBLISH_READING`).

Merge this series into another (`PUBLISH_READING` and `DELETE_CONTENT`): editions,
chapters, follows and progress move; this series stays as a redirect.
Publish a series (`PUBLISH_READING`).
Unpublish a series (`PUBLISH_READING` or `DELETE_CONTENT`).

get.summary:
Poll an upload: `awaiting_upload`, `queued`, `running`, `done`, `failed` or `expired`
(`PUBLISH_READING`).

post.summary:
The file is uploaded: check it and queue the conversion (`PUBLISH_READING`). Repeating the call
for a queued or finished upload returns it unchanged.

400.description: The file is missing or over the size limit.

delete.summary: Delete a volume; its chapters stay, ungrouped (`DELETE_CONTENT`).

get.summary: `GET /admin/me`: the caller's platform permissions (any staff member).
A Person and its accounts (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`). The read is logged.

post.summary: Platform-ban a Person (`PLATFORM_BAN`).
Clear a Person's suspicion level (reason required).
Lift a Person's ban; accounts return while the cap allows (`PLATFORM_BAN`).

get.summary:
The review queue: submitted and in review by default, for the kinds the caller may review
(`REVIEW_READING` for the Library kinds), never the caller's own submissions. Filters: kind,
state, `claimed=mine|unclaimed`, submitter, `min_age_hours`, title; sort and pagination.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Comma-separated states. Default: all for "my submissions", `submitted,in_review` for the queue.

parameters.name: min_age_hours
parameters.description: Queue only: only submissions waiting at least this many hours.

post.summary: Close a request without fulfilling it (reviewers of the section).

get.summary: A submission with items and the full timeline, internal notes included.

post.summary:
Approve: pending items are approved (rejected ones stay out) and the kind publishes. When
publishing fails the submission stays `approved` with a `publish_failed` note; call
`publish` to retry.
Claim a submission for 30 minutes (renews your own claim).

409.description: Not in the queue, or another reviewer holds the claim.

post.summary: A note on the timeline: public (the submitter sees it) or `internal`.

put.summary: Approve, reject (note required) or reset one item. Needs your live claim.

get.summary: Signed page URLs of a chapter under review (reviewers of the kind).
The kind's preview (Library: series facts, editions and the chapters under review).

post.summary: Publish an approved submission (the retry after a failed publish).

Publish your own draft without review (the kind's publish permission, e.g.
`PUBLISH_READING`).
Reject; `reason` is required and visible to the submitter.
Give the claim back; the submission returns to the queue.
Send the submission back to the submitter; `reason` is required and visible to them.

get.summary: Every editable platform setting with its current value (`MANAGE_FEATURES`).

patch.summary: Change platform settings and limits without a restart (`MANAGE_FEATURES`).

get.summary: List staff (`APPOINT_STAFF`).

post.summary: Appoint an account: adds it to the Staff Server with the roles (`APPOINT_STAFF`).

get.summary: Staff Server roles that can be assigned (`APPOINT_STAFF`).

delete.summary: Revoke an appointment (`APPOINT_STAFF`). The Owner cannot be revoked.

put.summary: Replace a staff member's roles (`APPOINT_STAFF`).

get.summary: Dashboard counts (`STAFF_BASIC`).
Persons with suspicion above zero, highest first.
System status: version, readiness probes, gateway sessions, queue depth (`OPERATOR`).
Jobs, newest first (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: A job id: only older jobs.

get.summary: One job with its log tail, encoder and warnings (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`).

post.summary:
Cancel a job (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`): a queued job stops at once, a running one when its worker
next reports.
Queue a failed or cancelled job again with a fresh attempt counter (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`).

get.summary: Queue depth: queued, running, and the last day's outcomes (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`).

post.summary:
Re-transcode one asset, a whole title or everything (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`): the ladder is
planned again from the stored probe and queued (a batch is capped at 500 assets; repeat for
the rest). The old files stay playable until the new ones are published.

Run the retention sweep now (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`): expired upload slots, originals and
proxies the retention policy lets go, unreferenced transcode prefixes, expired downloads. It
also runs hourly.

get.summary:
Worker tokens, newest first (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`). Only hashes are stored: the secret is shown
once, when the token is created.

post.summary:
Create a worker token (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`). The response carries the secret; it cannot be
shown again.

delete.summary:
Revoke a token (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`): it stops authenticating at once and the workers
registered with it are told to drain.

get.summary:
Workers that registered, with capabilities, last contact and the jobs they run
(`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`).

put.summary:
Tell a worker to finish its jobs and claim no more, or lift that (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`). The
worker learns it on its next heartbeat.

get.summary: Get a guild channel the caller can view.

delete.summary: Delete a guild channel; a deleted category orphans its children.

patch.summary: Modify a guild channel. Needs `MANAGE_CHANNELS`.

post.summary: Request an upload slot for each file.

413.description: File larger than the caller's limit

post.summary: Mark an uploaded file complete and learn its verified content type.

parameters.name: upload_id
parameters.description: Upload id from the slot response

get.summary: Active invites of a channel (`MANAGE_CHANNELS`).

post.summary:
Create an invite (`CREATE_INSTANT_INVITE`). With `external: true` the defaults
are single use; explicit `max_age`/`max_uses` always win.

get.summary: Get channel messages.

post.summary: Create a message.
post.description:
Mentions are parsed with `sr-markdown` and gated by permissions (`@everyone`,
unmentionable roles ping nobody). A repeated `nonce` from the same author in the
same channel within five minutes returns the original message instead of
creating another.

post.summary: Bulk delete 2-100 messages younger than 14 days (MANAGE_MESSAGES).

get.summary: Pins with pin times (Discord's newer shape). At most 250 pins exist, so one page.
Search one channel (or DM) the caller can read.

parameters.name: has
parameters.description: link, embed, file, image, video, sound, sticker, poll

get.summary: Get a single channel message.

delete.summary: Delete a message (author, or MANAGE_MESSAGES). Soft delete: purged after 30 days.

patch.summary: Edit a message (author only for content; embed suppression also by MANAGE_MESSAGES).

post.summary:
Acknowledge a message: the marker moves forward to it and the mention badge
resets. With `manual: true` ("mark as unread") the marker is set to exactly this
message and `mention_count` is restored.

delete.summary: Remove every reaction from a message (MANAGE_MESSAGES).

get.summary: List the users who reacted with an emoji.

delete.summary: Remove all reactions of one emoji (MANAGE_MESSAGES).

put.summary: Add the caller's reaction.

parameters.name: emoji
parameters.description: Unicode emoji, or `name:id` for custom emoji (URL-encoded)

delete.summary: Remove the caller's reaction.
Remove another user's reaction (MANAGE_MESSAGES).

post.summary:
Start a thread from a message. The thread's id is the message's id; a message can
have one thread. Needs `CREATE_PUBLIC_THREADS`.

put.summary: Create or replace a permission overwrite (`type` 0 role, 1 member).

delete.summary: Delete a permission overwrite.

get.summary: Legacy pins list (array of messages).

post.summary: Mark the channel's pins as seen.

put.summary: Pin a message (MANAGE_MESSAGES, max 250 per channel).

delete.summary: Unpin a message.

get.summary: Users who voted for an answer, ascending by id.

put.summary: Vote for an answer. A single-choice poll moves the caller's earlier vote.

400.description: Unknown answer or the poll has ended

delete.summary: Withdraw the caller's vote for an answer.

post.summary: End a poll now. Only the author can; the final results go out as `MESSAGE_UPDATE`.

put.summary:
Add a friend to a group DM. Adding to a 1:1 DM spawns a new group and returns
it (200); adding to a group answers 204.

delete.summary: Remove a member from a group DM (owner), or leave it (yourself).

get.summary: Members of a thread, ordered by user id (`after` pages; `limit` 1-100).

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Last user id of the previous page

get.summary: One thread member.

put.summary: Add a member to a thread (`@me` joins). The thread must not be archived.

delete.summary:
Remove a member from a thread (`@me` leaves). Removing others needs
`MANAGE_THREADS`, or being the owner of a private thread.

post.summary:
Start a thread without a message, or a post in a forum or media channel (then
`message` is required and becomes the first message).

get.summary: Every archived private thread of a channel. Needs `MANAGE_THREADS`.

Archived public threads (and forum posts) of a channel, newest archive first.
`before` is the ISO8601 `archive_timestamp` of the last thread of the previous page.

post.summary: Trigger the typing indicator.

get.summary: Archived private threads of a channel that the caller joined.
The live party of a channel or DM.

404.description: No party, or the channel is not visible.

get.summary: Webhooks of a channel (`MANAGE_WEBHOOKS`).

post.summary:
Create a webhook in a channel (`MANAGE_WEBHOOKS`; 15 per channel). The response
carries the token once.

get.summary:
Start playing an asset: master playlist URL, tracks, thumbnails and skip markers. The asset must belong to
a published title, episode, cut or trailer; a restricted title answers 403 with code 900011 until the
account confirmed it is 18 or older (D-184).

parameters.name: asset_id
parameters.description: Asset id from the play target

post.summary:
A new manifest grant for an asset being played, before the old one expires. Runs the same checks as
`playback`; nothing is stored per viewer.

parameters.name: asset_id
parameters.description: Asset id from the play target

get.summary: Published curated collections (the "Room selection" dropdown), by position.

delete.summary: Delete the caller's own comment (its replies go with it).

patch.summary: Edit the caller's own comment.

put.summary: Like a comment (idempotent). Answers the new count.

delete.summary: Take back a like. Answers the new count.

get.summary: Replies to a top-level comment, oldest first.

post.summary: Report a comment to the moderators.

get.summary: The home page: tonight's feature plus the rows in page order.
State of a download you started: `queued`, `preparing`, `ready` (with the link) or `failed`.

The file of a ready download: redirects to a signed CDN URL that works for a few minutes.
Only the member who started the download can use this link.

307.description: Redirect to the signed file URL.

get.summary: One episode.
Skip intro / credits / recap windows of an episode.

What the player needs to open an episode, with the next and previous playable episodes.
A restricted title needs age confirmation (403, code 900011).

403.description: Age-restricted title and the account has not confirmed it is 18 or older: error code 900011 (AGE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED). Show the 'Are you 18 or older?' dialog, POST /sr/age-gate, then retry.

get.summary: Genre, rating and language counts plus year and runtime bounds for the filters.
The caller's lists, My list first.

post.summary: Create a custom list (100 per account).

get.summary: A list with its items, if the caller owns it or its visibility allows.

delete.summary: Delete a custom list.

patch.summary: Rename, describe or change the visibility of a list.

put.summary: Add a title at the end of a list (idempotent; 1000 per list).

requestBody.description: Optional note; the body may be empty.

delete.summary: Remove a title from a list.

put.summary: Set the complete order of a list (the same titles, once each).

get.summary: Unfinished items to resume, and the next episode after a finished one, latest first.
Friends who are watching something now and share it (`cinema.share_watching`).
Watch history, newest first (every movie and episode separately).

delete.summary: Clear all watch history, progress included.

get.summary: Whether recording of history is paused.

put.summary: Pause or resume recording of history. While paused nothing is stored and no presence is shown.

get.summary: "My list": the saved titles, newest first.

put.summary: Save a title to My list (idempotent).

delete.summary: Remove a title from My list.

get.summary: "Because you watched X" rows for the caller's most recent titles.

delete.summary: End the caller's "watching" presence now.

put.summary: Mark a review helpful (idempotent; not on one's own).

delete.summary: Take back a helpful mark.

post.summary: Report a review to the moderators (a second report by the same account is accepted silently).

get.summary:
One row by key: `new-this-week`, `recently-added`, `anime-room`, `one-more-episode`,
`films`, `animation-banner`, `genre:<name>`, `collection:<id>` or a provided row such as
`continue-watching` or `trending` (other query parameters, for example `scope`, go to the
provider). An unknown key, or a provided row nobody provides, is 404.
Instant search: matching titles plus people, genre and tag suggestions.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search-box text; every word is matched as a prefix.

get.summary: Browse the catalog with filters, sort and keyset pagination.

parameters.name: genres
parameters.description: Comma-separated; a title must have every one.

parameters.name: exclude_genres
parameters.description: Comma-separated; a title with any of them is left out.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated; a title must have every one.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Comma-separated content ratings (`PG-13,R`); a title with any of them.

parameters.name: age
parameters.description: `include` (default), `hide` or `only`. Everyone may see restricted titles; opening them needs age confirmation. A member who set `cinema.hide_age_restricted` gets `hide` as the default.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Only the titles of this collection ("Room selection").

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: `asc` or `desc`; default depends on the sort.

get.summary: A title with its seasons, variants, trailers and skip markers. A merged title answers with its target.
Top-level comments on a title, newest first.

post.summary: Comment on a title, or reply to a top-level comment (`parent_id`).

get.summary:
The renditions a Patron can download for a title or episode, with sizes, which are already
prepared, and how many downloads are left today.

parameters.name: episode
parameters.description: For a series: the episode to download.

403.description: Not a Patron, or the title needs age confirmation (code 900011).

post.summary:
Start a download (or reuse the prepared file): the MP4 of the chosen rendition is made by a
stream-copy job and cached for 7 days. Counts against the daily limit (429 when used up).

403.description: Not a Patron, the original is not enabled, or age confirmation is needed.

429.description: The daily limit is used up.

get.summary: Seasons and episodes of a title, in season and episode order.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 500. Without it every episode is returned.

get.summary: Top-level comments on an episode, newest first.

post.summary: Comment on an episode, or reply to a top-level comment.

get.summary: The caller's progress in an episode.

404.description: No progress saved yet, or unknown title or episode.

put.summary: Save episode progress; see the movie variant for the rules.

delete.summary: Forget an episode's progress.

put.summary: Rate an episode 1 to 10.

delete.summary: Remove the caller's rating of an episode.

get.summary: Ratings of an episode.
Skip intro / credits / recap windows of a title (films).

What the player needs to open a title: the asset, markers and (for an episodic title) the
first playable episode. A restricted title needs age confirmation (403, code 900011).

parameters.name: variant
parameters.description: A variant (cut) of the title, for example the director's cut.

403.description: Age-restricted title and the account has not confirmed it is 18 or older: error code 900011 (AGE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED). Show the 'Are you 18 or older?' dialog, POST /sr/age-gate, then retry.

get.summary: The caller's progress in a movie.

404.description: No progress saved yet, or unknown title or episode.

put.summary:
Save movie progress (the player heartbeat, every 10 s while playing). With `base_updated_at_ms` a
newer stored position is kept and returned with `applied: false`; repeat with `force` to overwrite.
`completed` is automatic at 90%. `playing: false` also ends the "watching" presence.

delete.summary: Forget a movie's progress.

put.summary: Rate a title 1 to 10.

delete.summary: Remove the caller's rating of a title.

get.summary: The caller's rating of a title and the average per scope (global, friends, people who share a server).

put.summary: Write or replace the caller's review of a title (one per account). A `rating` also sets the rating.

delete.summary: Delete the caller's review of a title.

get.summary: Reviews of a title.
Every progress row of a title (episode ticks and the season/title watched state).

post.summary: Mark an episode, a season (`season`) or a whole title watched or unwatched.

get.summary:
Trending titles over the last 7 days in a scope. Only people whose `cinema.share_watching`
allows it are counted; age-restricted titles appear only in `friends`, for confirmed adults.
The lists of another member that the caller may see (public, or shared with friends).

post.summary:
Create a guild with `@everyone`, two categories, `#general` and a voice channel, or
from a template (`template`: a built-in id or a template code) in one transaction.

201.description: The new guild with its roles and channels

get.summary: The built-in templates of the Create a Server wizard (any signed-in user).
Preview a template by its code (any signed-in user).

post.summary:
Create a server from a template (a built-in id or a template code) in one
transaction; the caller owns it. One `GUILD_CREATE`.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Built-in template id or template code

201.description: The new guild with its roles and channels

get.summary: Get a guild (members only).

delete.summary: Delete a guild (owner only; the Staff Server cannot be deleted).

patch.summary: Modify a guild; `MANAGE_GUILD`, or the owner for `owner_id`.

post.summary:
Mark a whole guild as read: every channel the caller can view that has a message
is acknowledged up to its latest message (and its mention badge resets).

get.summary:
List audit-log entries, newest first (`VIEW_AUDIT_LOG`). Filter by `user_id`
and `action_type`; page with `before`.
List the guild's AutoMod rules (`MANAGE_GUILD`).

post.summary:
Create a rule (`MANAGE_GUILD`). Per-type quotas follow Discord: 6 keyword rules,
3 link rules, 1 of every other type.

post.summary:
`POST /sr/auth/email/cancel {token}`: the "This wasn't me" link of an email-change
notice. No login needed. While the change is still pending it is cancelled; once it
has completed, every session and trusted device is revoked instead. The token works
once, within 7 days.

204.description: Pending change cancelled, or all sessions revoked

post.summary:
`POST /sr/auth/email/change {new_email, password, mfa?}`: start an email change. A
confirmation link goes to the new address; the old one stays until it is used, and
receives a notice with a "This wasn't me" link. With two-factor authentication on,
`mfa {method, code}` is required unless this session passed a second-factor check
in the last 15 minutes. One request per minute per account. `204` also when the address belongs to
someone else, so the endpoint is not an account-existence oracle (the mail is
simply not sent).

204.description: Confirmation link sent, if the address is free

get.summary: `GET /sr/auth/passkeys`: the account's passkeys, oldest first.

post.summary: `POST /sr/auth/passkeys/login/begin {second_factor?}`: no login needed.

`POST /sr/auth/passkeys/login/finish`: complete a passkey-only login. Sets the
session cookie and answers `{status: "ok"}`. User verification was required, so no
further factor is asked.

`POST /sr/auth/passkeys/register/begin {password}`: re-check the password and
start a registration ceremony for the signed-in account.
`POST /sr/auth/passkeys/register/finish`: verify the new credential and store it.

`POST /sr/auth/passkeys/verify/begin`: start a second-factor ceremony for the
signed-in account (the email-change re-prompt). The result goes into
`mfa: {method: "passkey", code}` as a JSON string of
`{ceremony_id, credential}`.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /sr/auth/passkeys/{id} {password}`: remove a passkey (password re-check).
Removing the last second factor also drops the recovery codes.

patch.summary: `PATCH /sr/auth/passkeys/{id} {name}`: rename.

post.summary:
`POST /sr/auth/password {current_password, new_password, revoke_other_sessions?}`:
change the password of the signed-in account. The current password is checked
first (and counts toward the login lockout). By default every other session and
every trusted device is revoked; the current session always stays. A notice goes
to the account's email.

put.summary:
`PUT /sr/auth/username {username, password}`: change the login name. Same rules as
signup (`^[a-z0-9_.]{2,32}$`, not reserved), two changes per day. Returns the new
username. Friends and shared servers receive `USER_UPDATE`.
